entry.title: New: dsh-skill-manager
entry.summary: Skill Manager page in the DSH settings panel: browse system / user / workspace / preset skills, expand a skill to its file tree, view and edit files, import skills from a zip, and export or delete them (system skills read-only). Exact install spec: github:aks1st/dsh-skill-manager. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
